THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
086
Behind the image
51 / Paisley Wrap
REFERENCE 5817.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 038
Art direction: Relaxed summer glow, powder blue paisley against mustard yellow, casual
smartphone intimacy.
Photorealistic vertical lifestyle portrait of an original adult woman with long, straight honey-blonde
hair and pale blue-green eyes, natural makeup with glossy rose lips and a relaxed, slightly
parted-lip look at the camera. She wears a powder-blue satin paisley and floral bandana tied as a
cap and a white ribbed tank top. She sits against a mustard-yellow banquette and a white textured
plaster wall in a sunny cafe. Warm natural daylight, soft skin glow, casual summer snapshot,
shallow depth of field, no text or logos.
52 / Rafter Blossom
REFERENCE 5816.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 039
Art direction: Mediterranean bohemian, warm wood and white plaster, saturated red florals,
natural light.
Photorealistic vertical smartphone-style portrait of an original adult woman with long, straight
golden-blonde hair parted in the center, pale blue eyes, natural makeup with rosy cheeks and soft
nude-pink lips, taking a close selfie with a calm, direct gaze. She wears a sheer long-sleeve floral
top printed with large red roses on cream, trimmed with pink lace and lime-green piping at the
neckline. Rustic Mediterranean villa interior with dark exposed wooden ceiling beams, white
plaster walls and a vase of purple flowers softly blurred behind her. Warm natural light, bohemian
summer mood, no text or logos.
